About Us

Joe's Plumbing was founded in 1998 by Joe Russo, a third-generation Princeton plumber. Today the shop employs six licensed plumbers and two apprentices, all trained on modern trenchless repair techniques so a sewer-line replacement no longer means tearing up the whole yard. We are proud members of the Princeton Chamber of Commerce and sponsor the local Little League team every spring. Our shop keeps a fully stocked van roster so most same-day calls are resolved without a second trip back to the supply house.

Every plumber on staff carries a current New Jersey master or journeyman license, and every van is stocked each morning from the same supply list so a same-day call rarely needs a second visit. We publish flat-rate pricing for the most common jobs - a running toilet, a garbage disposal swap, a water heater flush - so a homeowner knows the cost before any work begins, not after. Beyond routine repairs, the crew handles whole-house repiping, sump pump installation, backflow-preventer testing for the township, and gas-line work for new kitchen ranges. We keep a loaner water heater on the truck for emergency swaps so a family is never without hot water overnight, and every job over five hundred dollars comes with a two-year warranty on both parts and labor. Princeton residents can also reach the shop after hours through the same phone number listed on every page of this site, and a real person - not a call center - answers around the clock, every day of the year.
